subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should WhatsApp adopt a Desktop browser identity for all linked-device sessions, and what recovery path should existing `openclaw/cli` pairings receive?
rationale: The implementation and live evidence support changing the identity, but existing pairings may require disruptive re-pairing, so maintainers must define the upgrade contract before implementation.

options.title: Desktop default with guided re-pair
options.body: Adopt the Desktop identity as the sole canonical mode and add doctor/setup detection with explicit one-time re-pair recovery guidance.

options.title: Configurable compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve the old identity by default and add an opt-in Desktop setting, avoiding forced re-pairing but expanding configuration and support burden.

options.title: Diagnostics without behavior change
options.body: Keep the current identity and add warnings, leaving group delivery unreliable for affected linked devices.

recommendation.title: Desktop default with guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Adopt the Desktop identity as the sole canonical mode and add doctor/setup detection with explicit one-time re-pair recovery guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent group-inbound reconnect work is the closest merged ownership signal for this connection lifecycle.
